skill.name: baoyu-post-to-x
skill.description: Post text, images, and long-form Markdown articles to X using Chrome browser automation.
skill.summary: Automates preview and publishing workflows for X posts and X Articles.
skill.author: JimLiu

security_audit.summary: The skill provides legitimate X posting features, but it relies on high-risk browser and host automation. Confirmed issues include external process execution, CDP control of a persistent Chrome profile, real paste keystrokes, anti-automation evasion, and unsafe handling of untrusted article content. Many markdown and template-literal alerts are false positives, but the remaining risks require remediation before broad marketplace publication.

remediation.suggestion: Remove bypass-oriented language and Chrome flags, or replace the workflow with official X API integrations and clear user consent controls.

remediation.issue: Persistent Chrome profile exposed through remote debugging
remediation.suggestion: Use an isolated temporary profile, close Chrome reliably, and document the local CDP exposure before any browser session starts.
Require explicit confirmation before paste actions, verify the target window, and provide a non-keystroke fallback where possible.
Escape AppleScript string values or restrict target applications to a fixed allowlist before invoking osascript.
Sanitize generated HTML and escape raw Markdown text before inserting content into the authenticated X page.
Block private IP ranges, require HTTPS, validate MIME types, enforce file-size limits, and clean temporary files reliably.

remediation.issue: Embedded audit verdict in package content
remediation.suggestion: Remove prewritten safety conclusions from packaged skill files so marketplace review is based only on trusted audit inputs.

content.value_statement: Posting X content from AI workflows is repetitive and error-prone. This skill prepares posts and articles, opens Chrome, and supports preview or publish workflows.
actual_capabilities: Composes X posts with text and up to four images.
Previews posts by default and publishes only when requested.
Publishes X Articles from Markdown files with title and cover image support.
Converts Markdown into HTML for the X Articles editor.
Copies image or HTML content to the system clipboard for browser paste workflows.
Uses a persistent Chrome profile so a logged-in X session can be reused.
limitations: Requires Chrome or Chromium, Bun, and a logged-in X account.
X Articles require an X Premium account.
Image paste may require clipboard or accessibility permissions.
The workflow may break if X changes its interface.

use_cases.title: Preview social posts
use_cases.description: Draft and preview X posts with images before deciding whether to publish.

use_cases.title: Publish release updates
use_cases.description: Turn Markdown announcements into X Articles with a cover image and formatted body.

use_cases.title: Prepare campaign content
use_cases.description: Create browser-ready posts and articles while keeping final publishing under review.

prompt_templates.title: Preview a Text Post
prompt_templates.prompt: Use baoyu-post-to-x to preview this X post: [message]. Do not publish it.

prompt_templates.title: Add Images to a Post
prompt_templates.prompt: Preview an X post with this text and attach these image paths: [paths]. Keep the post in preview mode.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a Markdown Article
prompt_templates.prompt: Convert this Markdown article for X Articles and show a browser preview. Use this file: [path].

prompt_templates.title: Publish After Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Publish the reviewed X Article from [markdown path] with cover image [path]. Use submit only after explicit confirmation.

output_examples.input: Preview an X post with one screenshot and no publishing.
output: Chrome opens on the X compose page.
The post text and screenshot are inserted.
The browser remains open so the user can review the draft.

output_examples.input: Prepare a Markdown article with a cover image.
output: The article title, cover image, and body are prepared for X Articles.
The draft is displayed in Chrome for manual review.
Publishing is skipped unless the submit option is requested.

output_examples.input: Publish a reviewed post after confirmation.
output_examples.output: The skill opens Chrome, fills the X composer, attaches requested media, and submits the post after the user approves publishing.

best_practices: Always preview content before using the submit option.
Use a dedicated Chrome profile for automation sessions.
Review X platform rules, rate limits, and account permissions before posting.
anti_patterns: Do not publish without a human review step.
Do not run the skill on untrusted Markdown files or unknown image URLs.
Do not use the workflow for spam, impersonation, or policy evasion.

faq.question: Does this skill post directly to X?
faq.answer: Yes. It can publish when the submit option is used, but preview mode is the default workflow.

faq.question: Does it require an X account?
faq.answer: Yes. Chrome must be logged in to the target X account before posting.

faq.question: Can it publish X Articles?
faq.answer: Yes. It can prepare X Articles from Markdown, but X Premium is required.

faq.question: Why does it use Chrome?
faq.answer: It uses Chrome browser automation to interact with the X web interface and reuse a logged-in session.

faq.question: Can it attach images?
faq.answer: Yes. Regular posts support up to four images, and articles can include a cover image.

faq.question: What should users review before installing?
faq.answer: Users should review the security audit because the skill uses host commands, clipboard access, and browser automation.
